enunciado: Represent the same graph with adjacency lists: an array of AdjNode heads, one linked list per vertex. Show each vertex's list and compare the memory used (list nodes) with the matrix's N*N cells.
objetivos: Go through a vertex's neighbors in O(degree)
pistas: Each undirected edge creates two nodes: one in each list.
Inserting at the head of the list is O(1).
With few edges, the list saves a lot of memory.
